message.content: Confirmed first violation and have the stored failing case — shrinking to a minimal reproduction and inspecting the controller breach.
The shrink distilled it to a clear controller over-force case. Now I'll verify the reproduction and inspect the state around the failure to diagnose the root cause.
Diagnostics show a sharp spike to ~580 N against an ~11 N limit — the limit check isn't clamping the commanded force. I'll test a fix by raising the force limit to confirm.
I've confirmed the force calculation exceeds the declared fmax and that relaxing the limit removes the violation. Now I'll file the complete triage report.
